description: This header file declares system utility functions related to file and folder existence checks, file type verification, and file creation. It is intended for use in a system-related module within a larger project.

methods.name: bbfdm_folder_exists
methods.description: Checks if a folder exists at the specified path.

methods.name: bbfdm_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: bbfdm_is_regular_file
methods.description: Determines if the file at the given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bbfdm_create_empty_file
methods.description: Creates an empty file at the given path if it does not exist.
